description.narrative: Bank One, established in 1997, is a leading bank in trade finance and digital banking technology in Mauritius. It is equally owned by I&M Bank Group of Kenya (which has banking subsidiaries in five countries in Africa), and by CIEL Finance. Through its shareholders, Bank One has a wide reach and access across Africa (over 10 countries).

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: This $50 million risk sharing agreement aims to enable Bank One to extend trade finance support to smaller African markets (known as 'Alpha' countries in our strategy, those most in need according to their GDP per capita, fragility measures and poverty gap). This includes countries where we have had limited exposure in the past. It will also support Bank Oneís ambition to expand trade finance support in new markets, particularly in West and Central Africa.
